featured_stories.title: Intensifications of El Niño
featured_stories.blurb: As an El Niño of historic proportions is taking shape in the tropical Pacific, a University of Michigan study has found that El Niño variability has become nearly 40% stronger in the last 40 years than in the preindustrial era.

featured_stories.title: Great Lakes legacy
featured_stories.blurb: A University of Michigan Engineering alum cultivates craftsmanship and community for local and global impact. Ben Van Dam leads design and production of one-of-a-kind vessels that bring world-class craftspeople to Boyne City, supporting the local economy and spreading Michigan-made artisanship around the globe.

featured_stories.title: Papyrus conservation
featured_stories.blurb: An international cohort of conservation students recently attended the University of Michigan's 2026 Papyrus Conservation Summer Seminar. Working alongside U-M conservators and papyrologists, participants preserved more than 150 papyrus fragments, including manuscripts that had not been opened, flattened or read in nearly 2,000 years.

featured_stories.title: Depth objects
featured_stories.blurb: U-M artist and architecture professor Catie Newell designed glass 'Depth objects' for a short tour through the Faculty Arts Ambassador Program, offering participants a chance to explore grief, care and life transitions through touch, conversation and art—transforming grief into something tangible.

mission: The mission of the University of Michigan is to serve the people of Michigan and the world through preeminence in creating, communicating, preserving and applying knowledge, art, and academic values, and in developing leaders and citizens who will challenge the present and enrich the future.
